question: TWSP is related to MPLI in a certain way based on the English alphabetical order. In the same way, LOKH is related to EHDA. To which of the given options is PSOL related, following the same logic?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/bd3c600bf09d7de25d7d22479d848ddead62c9f7437c41312681e3719e85d12d.png] 

The logic followed here is:

**For TWSP to MPLI**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/1b8dde709b7cc3b4dea044a374728126a61ac605f3977c741a92ed30cae29661.png] 

**For LOKH to EHDA**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/5e66c718981617f05b618a83c2edbda1672d9d794c919fe7fa4c049892e2e10f.png] 

 

**Applying the same logic to PSOL:**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/5cfd7eb3443c7f58d0738123e8bcd41686f7c886ae95b310a7e4de6dc6bbc245.png] 

 

Thus, **PSOL** is related to **ILHE**.

Hence, the correct answer is **"ILHE".**
